messages:
Alex: Quick sync — proposing a short weekly deconflict slab for SI co-sell leads. Need to finalise handoff rules between marketplace, field, and SI for HW/on-prem deals. who’s in?
Maria: +1. We keep getting marketplace leads that are actually HW integration plays. Confusing ownership.
Jon: Can we codify a simple mapping? e.g. marketplace inbound -> AE owns unless tags include 'SI-engage' or deal > 250k -> SI-led.
Kayla: That sounds good as a start. Also need a rule for partner-introduced leads: if SI introduces and is active in first 30 days => SI retains; otherwise field can claim after 
Alex: Agree. Also two edge cases: (1) joint announcements — marketing needs a confirmed owner before the deal is signed; (2) hardware partners want co-marketing if they bring the ICP.
Maria: For joint announcements, require a signed co-announcement NDA + comms brief in Confluence. Otherwise we don’t promise partner placement.
Jon: Implementation note — we should add a lead tag flow in SFDC: SI-intro, Marketplace, HW-partner, Joint-announce-OK. That will make automations possible.
Kayla: I can draft the tag list. Also propose a one-page matrix (claim conditions, SLAs for response, escalation path). I’ll mock it and post tomorrow.
MarketplaceBot: New intake rule automation deployed: marketplace leads now append source_tag=marketplace and auto-assign to AE queue for 24h. See: https://confluence.redwood.ai/partnerships/marketplace-intake
Alex: Nice — that helps. For escalation: if AE doesn’t respond in 24h and lead has 'SI-interest' -> auto-notify the SI rep and partnership ops.
Maria: Can we add a cost-sensitivity flag for HW deals? If flagged, route to SI/solutions first — they’ll know hardware pricing impacts.
Jon: Yes — add 'hw-cost-sensitive' tag. Also note: for Dedicated/private deployments, legal/COMMS has to sign off on the announcement checklist.
Kayla: I’ll include that in the matrix. Draft actions: 1) Kayla to post matrix + proposed SFDC tags (tomorrow). 2) Ops to add automation for 24h reassign + escalate (ops: @Jon). 3) Partnerships to define co-announcement NDA template (Maria).
Alex: Solid. Let’s trial this cadence for 3 weeks and iterate. Weekly sync: Fridays 9am PT, 30m. I’ll add recurring invite.
Maria: 👍 will review NDA draft once up.
Jon: Ops will prototype automation in sandbox this week. ping me if you need test leads.
Kayla: Posting draft in #partnerships tomorrow and linking here.
Alex: Thanks team. Short and concrete — exactly what we need. :rocket:
